zh.headline: Anthropic 发现 Claude 内部存在类似人类意识的“全局工作空间”
zh.observation: 今天最强烈的信号是**AI 行业正在经历从“模型军备竞赛”到“落地能力竞赛”的转折点**。一方面，腾讯 Hy3、智谱 ZCode 等产品表明开源模型和 AI 编码工具的价格/性能比正在快速优化，开发者受益明显；另一方面，Anthropic 的“全局工作空间”发现和 Nvidia 硬件延期分别从软件和硬件两端提醒我们，行业的基础设施和认知边界都远未稳定。**Agent 安全威胁从理论走向现实**（JADEPUFFER 勒索软件）和**模型工具调用可靠性下降**（Better Models, Worse Tools）这两个信号值得所有 AI builder 高度警惕——当模型越来越强时，系统的脆弱面也在同步放大。

en.headline: Anthropic discovers a "global workspace" inside Claude mirroring theories of consciousness
en.observation: The strongest signal today is that **the AI industry is transitioning from a "model arms race" to a "capability deployment race."** On one hand, products like Tencent Hy3 and Zhipu ZCode show rapid optimization of open-source model and AI coding tool price/performance, clearly benefiting developers. On the other hand, Anthropic's "global workspace" discovery and Nvidia's hardware delays remind us from both software and hardware sides that the industry's infrastructure and cognitive boundaries are far from stable. **Agent security threats moving from theory to reality** (JADEPUFFER ransomware) and **declining model tool call reliability** (Better Models, Worse Tools) are two signals all AI builders should watch closely—as models grow stronger, system vulnerabilities amplify in parallel.
